Files are processed in this page

No account, file upload, browser storage, or telemetry. Clearing or leaving releases page references and download links. It does not delete files you downloaded or guarantee secure memory erasure.

Before you start

Will it treat 001 and 1 as the same key?

No. Values are compared as exact strings by default.

Do I need to upload my files to an account?

No. The page processes selected files in memory.

What happens when a key is duplicated?

Reconciliation stops and identifies the conflicting rows; it never guesses a pairing.
